name: DescribeDisks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a number that is greater than 0.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为50行。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

In-use: The disk is in use.

Available: The disk is available.

Attaching: The disk is being attached.

Detaching: The disk is being detached.

Creating: The disk is being created.

ReIniting: The disk is being re-initialized.

Deleting: The disk is being deleted.

Deleted: The disk is deleted.

Expiring: The disk is about to expire
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘状态。

In-use：使用中
Available：待挂载
Attaching：挂载中
Detaching：卸载中
Creating：创建中
ReIniting：重置中
Deleting：释放中
Deleted：已释放
Expiring：即将过期
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the disk. Valid values:

system: system disk

data: data disk
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘属性

system：系统盘
data：数据盘
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk

cloud_ssd: standard SSD

local_hdd: local HDD

local_ssd: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘种类。

高效云盘：cloud_efficiency
全闪云盘：cloud_ssd
本地HDD盘：local_hdd
本地盘SSD：local_ssd
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the disk. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型。

prepay：预付费
postpay：按量付费
parameters.name: disk_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The sorting order. The value is a JSON string. Example: {"EnsRegionId":"desc"}. By default, results are sorted by node ID in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序使用：格式例子{"EnsRegionId":"desc"}。默认按节点ID降序排列
parameters.name: order_by_params

parameters.help_en:
The purchasing model of the disk. Valid values:

ServiceDisk: The disk is created for an edge service.

ResoureDisk: The disk is purchased with the instance.

PostPayDisk: The disk is purchased separately
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘购买方式。

ServiceDisk：边缘服务创建磁盘
ResoureDisk：随实例购买
PostPayDisk：单独购买
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The instance to which the disk is attached
parameters.name: instance_id
